title: deposit.created v1
description: Published on subject deposit.created when a deposit enters status created: the provider's notification is recorded, nothing is booked yet. Nats-Msg-Id is <deposit_id>.created (one per deposit), so the stream drops repeated announcements within its duplicate window. Carries our IDs (TypeIDs) only, never provider identifiers. Consumers ignore unknown fields. Hand-written; shared by the Node and Go implementations.

event_id.description: Identifies this business event. A deposit can be announced more than once (a re-announcement after a failed publish gets a new event_id); consumers are idempotent on the deposit's state.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units (cents) as a string of digits, greater than zero.

occurred_at.description: When the deposit entered status created.
